libgs GetClut(x, y) → CLUT id. Returns `(y << 6) | ((x >> 4) & 0x3F)`. The 16-bit value goes into polygon `clut` field (POLY_FT4/etc). 5 callers SCUS-side; 7 callers OPEN.BIN-side (all menu/UI CLUT picks). [SD]

column1: # === Unit sprite rendering pipeline: state machine + facing/pose-octant [VERIFIED static (battle_disassembly.txt) + Godot AnimationStateController/CinematicPoseLUT; GetPoseOctantTest/CinematicPoseLUTTest/CinematicFacingResolverTest] ===

column5: Per-unit per-frame animation state machine + facing/pose resolution (PSX_UNIT_SPRITE_RENDERING section 3). Resolves on-screen facing by composing unit facing with camera: uVar5 = (work_rotation_y + unit+0x70) & 0xfff (12-bit); quadrant = uVar5>>10 (0-3, cardinal SEQ slot front/side/back); pose_octant = uVar5>>8 (0-15, mirror/flip + fine slot). Stores quadrant->unit+0x6c and pose_octant->unit+0x6e (sh at 0x80085e50 new-anim / 0x800861d8 facing-changed) and ORs mirror flags into unit+0x12 (bit1 flip_H, bit2 flip_V). anim_command(+0x0c)==3 clears the 3 WEP/EFF slots, computes the SEQ slot, zeroes move/screen offsets, calls seq_interp_type1(first_frame=1); ==0 advances via wait_timer(+0x1e2) or re-resolves when pose_octant changes; then ticks the 3 sub-anim slots into seq_interp_wep_eff. [VERIFIED static: octant stores at 0x80085e50/0x800861d8; Godot AnimationStateController.gd ((a>>10)&3, (facing+psx_camera-0x400)&0xfff) + CinematicPoseLUT.gd mirrors FUN_80085c0c stack-locals; GetPoseOctantTest, CinematicPoseLUTTest, CinematicFacingResolverTest; ADR-0039] [SD] [MD:PSX_UNIT_SPRITE_RENDERING.md]

Pose-octant derivation inside unit_anim_state_machine: sra a1,v0,0x8 = (work_rotation_y+facing)>>8, the 4-bit pose_octant (0-15) that indexes the mirror-flag/fine-slot lookups. Mid-function branch target LAB_80085df0 (XREF from 0x80085de4 bgez), not a callable entry. [VERIFIED Godot: == AnimationStateController.gd composed pose-octant; CinematicPoseLUT sub-tables A/B indexed by this 4-bit value] [SD] [MD:PSX_UNIT_SPRITE_RENDERING.md]

Continuing-animation facing re-resolve path in unit_anim_state_machine (LAB_80086308, XREF from 0x80085dfc beq). Tests the 0x1000000 frozen/petrified bit of status_flags(+0x80), compares the new pose_octant against stored unit+0x6e, and on change re-derives the SEQ slot from seq_slot(+0x1dc) (cardinal table when anim<6) before restarting the interpreter (zeroes +0x1de seq_offset / +0x1e2 wait_timer at 0x800861e0/e4). [SD] [MD:PSX_UNIT_SPRITE_RENDERING.md]

column1: # === Unit sprite rendering pipeline: SEQ interpreters + SHP subframe assembly [VERIFIED static (battle_disassembly.txt) + Godot AnimationPlayback/AnimationOpcodes/Shp parse] ===

column5: TYPE1 (unit body) SEQ bytecode interpreter (PSX_UNIT_SPRITE_RENDERING section 4). Called by unit_anim_state_machine to start or advance the main animation. Resolves the SEQ pointer table from seq_anim_id (anim_state+0x04): slot<0x1f4 -> per-unit table at anim_state+0x20; 0x1f4<=slot<0x258 -> seq_ptr_table_wep (0x800a77d8, slot-=0x1f4); slot>=0x258 -> seq_ptr_table_eff (0x800aed3c, slot-=0x258). A non-0xFF byte is a frame-index delta (anim_state+0x14 base + delta) -> sprite_subframe_assemble; the next byte is the wait count (-> wait_timer +0x1e2). 0xFF introduces the 0xBE-0xFF opcode table (movement via unit_anim_move_*, flip 0xEB/0xEC, distortion 0xC0/0xC1, shadow 0xE0/0xE1, layer 0xE2, sound 0xD9, jump/loop 0xFC/0xFD, end/pause 0xFE/0xFF). [VERIFIED static: slot-range branches at 0x8008485c/0x80084874 + base loads at 0x80084884/0x80084894; Godot AnimationPlayback.gd / AnimationOpcodes.gd interpret the same stream] [SD] [MD:PSX_UNIT_SPRITE_RENDERING.md]

WEP1/EFF1 sub-animation SEQ interpreter (PSX_UNIT_SPRITE_RENDERING section 5). Operates on a 0x30-byte sub-anim slot (unit+0x208/+0x238/+0x268); same bytecode as seq_interp_type1 but a reduced opcode set (world-movement opcodes are skipped; only MoveScreenXY 0xF9 and QueueSpriteAnim 0xF2 act) and builds the sprite buffer inline rather than via sprite_subframe_assemble. WEP (slot+0x02==1) TPAGE x=9 / EFF (==2) TPAGE x=8; clut = unit clut_base + slot_index*0x40 + 0x80; piece_count capped at 3. WEP V coord adds wep_v_offset_base_table (0x800943e5). [VERIFIED static: prologue addiu sp,-0x68, 0x800943e5 read at 0x800852bc; Godot WEP/EFF sub-anim slots, AnimationOpcodes.gd] [SD] [MD:PSX_UNIT_SPRITE_RENDERING.md]

SHP frame decoder / subframe assembler (PSX_UNIT_SPRITE_RENDERING section 6). Used by seq_interp_type1; seq_interp_wep_eff does the equivalent inline. Frame header byte 0: piece_count = (b0 & 7)+1 (1-8; WEP/EFF cap 3); rotation_index = b0>>3 (5-bit) -> sprite_rotation_angle_table[idx] -> sprite_buffer+0x0c (negated when unit H-flipped). Each 4-byte piece: signed shift_x/shift_y + a 16-bit bitfield (U>>3 bits0-4, V>>3 bits5-9, size_index bits10-13, flip_x bit14, flip_y bit15); width=sprite_piece_width_table[size_index], height=sprite_piece_height_table[size_index]; emitted via sprite_buffer_write_piece. size_index 0xE on non-human (sprite_type!='I'/'A') splits into two 48x24 halves; monster units (sprite_type>0x9a) use TPAGE x=0xB. [VERIFIED static: prologue addiu sp,-0x58, table loads at 0x800842c4/0x80083e9c/0x80083ea8; Godot Shp subframe parse, CinematicPoseLUT frame-base sub-tables] [SD] [MD:PSX_UNIT_SPRITE_RENDERING.md]

Writes one assembled subframe piece (7 bytes: shift_x, shift_y, width, height, U, V, flags) into the sprite buffer at +0x0e + piece*7 and bumps the buffer piece count. Called by sprite_subframe_assemble and the inline WEP/EFF path; the buffer is read back by the GTE GPU submit poly_ft4_packet_builder (0x8007af44). flags bit0 semi-transparency, bit1 flip_x, bit2 flip_y, bit7 split-half marker. [SD via disasm: leaf fn, XREFs from the subframe/idle assemble sites] [MD:PSX_UNIT_SPRITE_RENDERING.md]

WEP SEQ pointer table base used by seq_interp_type1 for animation slots 0x1f4-0x257 (indexed (slot-0x1f4)*4). Loaded as lui 0x800a / addiu 0x77d8 at 0x80084880-0x80084884; runtime-populated (zeroed in the static image). [SD via disasm] CORRECTS the source doc, which mis-cited this table as 0x8006a7d8 (that address resolves to code). [MD:PSX_UNIT_SPRITE_RENDERING.md]

column5: Per-unit per-frame sprite render dispatch (PSX_UNIT_SPRITE_RENDERING section 9). Loads global sprite_scale_x/y/z, then walks the 4-entry config unit_layer_ordering_table + (unit+0x14)*0x10: entry 0 renders the TYPE1 body buffer (unit+0x204); entries 1-3 render an active WEP/EFF sub-anim slot buffer ((entry-1)*0x30 + unit+0x22c, gated by slot active at +0x208). All layers share screen pos (unit+0x120/0x122), depth bucket (unit+0x128) and global scale, submitted via poly_ft4_packet_builder (0x8007af44). mount_mode(+0x130)==2 renders rider (split at piece 3) plus mount; shadow via FUN_8007d5d0 when +0x298; distortion via FUN_8007f2ac when +0x2e8. [VERIFIED static: prologue addiu sp,-0x78, layer-table *0x10 + slot +0x208 reads at 0x800867dc-0x80086818; Godot layer-priority / SetLayerPriority (opcode 0xE2) equivalent] [SD] [MD:PSX_UNIT_SPRITE_RENDERING.md]

Facing-dependent forward/back world-move (PSX_UNIT_SPRITE_RENDERING section 10). Reads facing quadrant (unit+0x70 & 0xc00) and writes the signed amount into world-offset unit+0x50 (X) or +0x54 (Z): 0x000->+0x50-=a, 0x400->+0x54+=a, 0x800->+0x50+=a, 0xc00->+0x54-=a. Drives SEQ opcodes 0xF0/0xFA; offsets consumed in build_unit_sprite_svector before projection. [VERIFIED static: leaf fn lhu v0,0x70(a0), XREF[2] 0x80084bb8/0x80084f00; Godot world move-offset mirror] [SD] [MD:PSX_UNIT_SPRITE_RENDERING.md]

Vertical world-move helper: unit+0x52 += (signed char)amount (positive=down, negative=up). Drives SEQ opcodes 0xCB-0xD0 (MoveUp/Down) and 0xEF/0xFA. [VERIFIED static: leaf fn, sll a1,a1,0x18 sign-extend then lhu 0x52(a0), XREF[6]; Godot vertical move-offset] [SD] [MD:PSX_UNIT_SPRITE_RENDERING.md]

Facing-dependent lateral (left/right) world-move, perpendicular to forward: facing (unit+0x70 & 0xc00) selects unit+0x50 or +0x54 with the opposite sign pattern to unit_anim_move_forward_back. Drives SEQ opcodes 0xCD/0xCE/0xD1/0xD2 and 0xEE/0xFA. [VERIFIED static: leaf fn lhu v0,0x70(a0), XREF[5]; Godot lateral move-offset] [SD] [MD:PSX_UNIT_SPRITE_RENDERING.md]

Unit sprite layer ordering configs read by unit_sprite_render_dispatch: base + (unit+0x14)*0x10, four 4-byte entries per config (config selected by opcode 0xE2 SetLayerPriority). Entry 0 = TYPE1 body, entries 1-3 = WEP/EFF sub-anim slot (value-1). Indexed at 0x800867dc/0x800867e8. [SD via disasm load sites; Godot animation_layer_priorities / SetLayerPriority equivalent] [MD:PSX_UNIT_SPRITE_RENDERING.md]

column1: # === Display present / double-buffer swap (Instruction->Render pipeline stages 6-8) [VERIFIED static: libgpu debug-string self-ID + frame_sync/display_swap_buffers index math] ===

# The GPU renders the OT into DRAWENV[idx]'s VRAM block; PutDispEnv(DISPENV[idx]) then scans out the just-drawn block. idx is one 0/1 toggle shared by both env arrays -> proper double-buffer (opposite VRAM blocks, TOP y[0,240] / BOTTOM y[240,480]). See INSTRUCTION_TO_RENDER.md sec 7-8.

column5: libgpu DrawSync(mode): block until the GPU drawing queue drains (mode 0). Called before the VBlank wait in both the SCUS display_swap_buffers (0x80041774) and the BATTLE frame_sync (0x80093a98). [VERIFIED static: self-identifies via its own debug string "DrawSync(%d)...\n" @0x800107b4] [MD:INSTRUCTION_TO_RENDER.md]

libgpu PutDrawEnv(env): install a DRAWENV (drawing environment: draw area/offset/clip) into the GPU. Fed DRAWENV[idx] = g_drawenv_double_buffer (0x8004ea14) + idx*0x5c by display_swap_buffers and frame_sync. [VERIFIED static: self-identifies via its own debug string "PutDrawEnv(%08x)...\n" @0x80010860] [MD:INSTRUCTION_TO_RENDER.md]

libgpu PutDispEnv(env): install a DISPENV (display environment: which VRAM rect is scanned out) into the GPU -- the actual buffer-swap present. Fed DISPENV[idx] = g_dispenv_double_buffer (0x8004eacc) + idx*0x14 by display_swap_buffers and frame_sync. DISPENV.disp.y (0 vs 240) selects the TOP vs BOTTOM 256x240 block. [VERIFIED static: self-identifies via its own debug string "PutDispEnv(%08x)...\n" @0x80010894] [MD:INSTRUCTION_TO_RENDER.md]

Full double-buffer present: TOGGLES g_display_buffer_index (0x8004597c) via `idx = (idx==0)` (sltiu idx,idx,1 @0x80041798), then DrawSync(0) -> kernel_vblank_wait -> PutDispEnv(DISPENV[idx]) -> PutDrawEnv(DRAWENV[idx]). This is the site that actually flips the buffer index; the BATTLE frame_sync (0x80093a98) RE-PRESENTS the current index each game-loop iteration without toggling. [VERIFIED static: prologue addiu sp,-0x28, toggle+present sequence @0x80041788-0x80041808, XREF from 0x80041acc/0x80041cfc] [MD:INSTRUCTION_TO_RENDER.md]

Active double-buffer index (0/1). Toggled by display_swap_buffers (0x80041774) at 0x800417a0; read by both the swap and the BATTLE frame_sync (0x80093a98) to select DISPENV[idx] (0x8004eacc, stride 0x14) and DRAWENV[idx] (0x8004ea14, stride 0x5c). Both envs use the SAME index but point at OPPOSITE VRAM blocks. NB: immediately precedes g_gameloop_vblank_wait_count (0x80045980). [VERIFIED static: sltiu-toggle + PutDispEnv/PutDrawEnv index math] [MD:INSTRUCTION_TO_RENDER.md]

Two-entry DRAWENV array (libgpu drawing environment, stride 0x5c/92 bytes): [0]=0x8004ea14, [1]=0x8004ea70. Element idx = g_display_buffer_index selects which VRAM block the GPU renders the OT into; installed via PutDrawEnv. [VERIFIED static: base computed as 0x80050000-0x15ec, idx*0x5c index math @0x80093ba0-0x80093bbc] [MD:INSTRUCTION_TO_RENDER.md]

Two-entry DISPENV array (libgpu display environment, stride 0x14/20 bytes): [0]=0x8004eacc, [1]=0x8004eae0. Element idx = g_display_buffer_index selects which VRAM rect is scanned out; installed via PutDispEnv. DISPENV.disp.y (0 vs 240) picks the TOP y[0,240] vs BOTTOM y[240,480] 256x240 block. [VERIFIED static: base computed as 0x80050000-0x1534, idx*0x14 index math @0x80093b78-0x80093b8c] [MD:INSTRUCTION_TO_RENDER.md]

column1: # === Unit shadow rendering [VERIFIED live 2026-07-03: PCSX BP fire + raw POLY_FT4 packet + VRAM blob extract; UNIT_SHADOW_RENDERING.md] ===

column5: Renders a unit's ground shadow as ONE semi-transparent, subtractively-blended, texture-mapped POLY_FT4 (GPU code 0x2E, TPAGE 0x5F land / 0x3F water): a fixed 20x20 world-unit quad pinned to the terrain tile under the unit's feet, draped over slopes, GTE-projected, inserted as its own OT primitive at slot ot_base + unit[0x128]*4. Footprint NEVER scales with jump/fly height (ground-locked; Y snaps per-tile via (tile[+2]+(tile[+3]>>5))*-0xC). Called from unit_sprite_render_dispatch (0x80086640) gated on unit[0x298]!=0; forces unit[0x299]|1, calls unit_shadow_build_corners (0x8007b9d0), addPrim @0x8007daf4, then clears the dirty bit. Toggled by anim opcodes 0xE0 HideShadow / 0xE1 ShowShadow and event instr 0x4E Unit Shadow. [VERIFIED: prologue addiu sp,-0x58; live packet code=2E tpage=005F rgb0=808080] [MD:UNIT_SHADOW_RENDERING.md]

Builds the four ground-space SVECTOR corners of the shadow quad into unit+0x29c..+0x2b8 (corners[4], consumed by the RTPS projection in unit_shadow_render). Snaps the unit's animated ground position (+0x40) to the tile and drapes each corner by the tile-shape byte tile[+4]; no height term -> this is WHY the shadow never scales with airborne height. [VERIFIED static: prologue addiu sp,-0x30; live +0x29c..2b8 populated on return] [MD:UNIT_SHADOW_RENDERING.md sec 2.2]

Combat-path producer of the sprite cardinal index (which of the 8 rotation views to draw) from unit facing (+0x70, 12-bit angle) combined with the camera offset: cardinal_idx = ((facing+cam_off) & 0xfff) >> 0xa (2 bits), pose octant = >>8 (4 bits). Same formula as the scenario facing resolver but a distinct function; dormant on the scenario/event path (fires 0x there). [VERIFIED static: prologue addiu sp,-0x20; formula bit-exact per HANDOFF_sprite_cardinal_mapping] [MD:PSX_UNIT_SPRITE_RENDERING.md]

jal event_dialogue_tick (0x8012f6d4); ra=0x80132728. BOTH the prayer overlay and the boxed dialog enter the per-glyph tick through this ONE call site; the per-mode speed difference is carried by the a2 (per-glyph frame budget) argument (overlay 5 / boxed 1), NOT the call site. [VERIFIED live: a2 traced at both modes, ra=0x80132728 for both] [MD:TYPEWRITER_TEXT_CADENCE.md sec 7.0]

Per-glyph emit/sleep loop inside event_dialogue_tick (0x8012fb84..0x8012fbec): runs a2*(3-throttle) iterations (mult s5,(3-throttle)), each one a single-frame yield via event_fiber_yield_n(1) (0x8014c858 -> event_fiber_yield 0x8014ca80), so it SLEEPS the whole inter-glyph gap. One tick reveals exactly one glyph, hence tick-entry cadence = glyph cadence = a2*(3-throttle) VBlanks. [VERIFIED live; loop structure confirmed by disasm] [MD:TYPEWRITER_TEXT_CADENCE.md sec 7.0]

Base VBlank-wait count consumed by the game-loop frame sync (0x80093a98) on the else/cinematic branch (N = this), then passed to the kernel VBlank wait (0x8001dba8). Sets game-loop iterations per VBlank; the master clock the text typewriter rides on. [VERIFIED live: =1 during the chapel prayer cinematic] [MD:TYPEWRITER_TEXT_CADENCE.md sec 2.A]

Sleep-N-frames helper: calls event_fiber_yield (0x8014ca80) exactly a0 times (counted loop 0x8014c874..0x8014c880; blez a0 fast-out). NOT the yield primitive itself -- it is the multi-frame wrapper (~20 callers across event opcode handlers). The typewriter emit loop (0x8012fb84) calls it with a0=1 per iteration, so the earlier note calling 0x8014c858 'event_fiber_yield' was a misnomer (behaviour right, name wrong). [CONFIRMED by disasm] [MD:TYPEWRITER_TEXT_CADENCE.md sec 7.0]

Writes the unit 16-colour BGR555 CLUT staging bank (base 0x800e4ea4). Prologue addiu sp,-0x68. [VERIFIED live: scenario_1 prayer/door] [MD:UNIT_FADE_COLOR_UNIT_OPCODE.md]

Screen-blend (Map Darkness {1A}) track mode/flag; mode 10 = STOP clears the track. [MD:map_darkness_oxide_decode.md]
Screen-blend current colour R, 16.16 fixed (>>16 = applied 8-bit). +0x4 = G (0x800a1b5c), +0x8 = B (0x800a1b60). [VERIFIED live] [MD:map_darkness_oxide_decode.md]

DDA intensity-curve table shared by the CLUT tint engine {32} and screen darkening {1A}: the SLOW table = 63 rows x 32 cols (int8), 2016 bytes (file 0x2E6E4), used when Time>=4 (one 32-col step every Time>>2 frames). Immediately followed in RAM by the separate FAST sub-table color_ramp_curve_table_fast (0x80095ec4, 63x8, used when Time<4): 0x80095ec4-0x800956e4 = 0x7e0 = 63*32, so this table spans exactly 0x800956e4..0x80095ec4. Row index = biased per-frame step (target-current)+0x1f (0..62); row 0x1f=identity, 0x27=brighten, 0x17=darken; each row's steps sum to land the channel exactly on target. CORRECTED 2026-07-06: was "32 rows" -- the address delta to the fast table proves 63 rows. [VERIFIED static: RAM delta to fast table = 0x7e0 = 63*32] [MD:UNIT_FADE_COLOR_UNIT_OPCODE.md §10.1]

Called from scene mode-sequencer 0x8008ea6c case 0. The 14 views == the 14 VRAM rows (494..507) blitted by flush_clut_view_strip (0x80092f98). [VERIFIED static: decomp FUN_80093048 + writer-trace showing 0x800e4ea4 = BGR555 CLUT banks] [MD:prayer_screen_tint_quad_decode.md]

column1: # --- Scenario event VM: cooperative-task interpreter + Wait For Instruction {E5} ---

column5: Top-level scenario event-script VM: a chained bne s4,<op> opcode ladder (body 0x80143bd8..0x80145f78). Prologue self-registers as cooperative-task slot1 kind 0x44 (ori a0,0x44 @0x80143bdc; jal event_task_set_kind @0x80143c04). Per-instruction fetch @0x80143d0c reads chunk bytes via DAT_80173ca4: opcode->s4 (lbu 0x0 @0x80143d30), operand-lo->s2 (lbu 0x1 @0x80143d20), operand-hi->s5 (lbu 0x2 @0x80143d24). Hosts the {E5} Wait For Instruction case (evt_wfi_E5_poll_case 0x80145964). DISTINCT from the nested Block-Start interpreter BATTLE_block_start_event_instruction (0x8013e904) -- a kind-8 child coroutine with no {E5} case. [VERIFIED: prologue kind 0x44 + fetch disasm-direct; slot1 kind 0x44 live-dumped] [SD] [MD:wait_for_instruction_halt_decode.md]

Cooperative-task kind setter: writes a0 into the CURRENT coroutine slot's +0x4c (kind key). idx=DAT_80174038 (thread index); sw a0,(0x801698b8 + idx*0x400) @0x80149d60 == slot0(0x8016986c)+0x4c. Each event fiber calls this once with its kind constant (interpreter 0x44, dialog 1, camera 4, block 8, EVTCHR 0x34, dark-screen 0x36, screen-fx 0x3d). This +0x4c is exactly what {E5} Wait For Instruction(Task=N) polls against. 21 callers. [VERIFIED: sw a0,0x4c disasm-direct; +0x4c==kind live-matched (Task=4 -> slot2 key4)] [SD] [MD:wait_for_instruction_halt_decode.md]

{E5} Wait For Instruction(Task=N) case body inside event_scenario_interpreter. Builds key s6=(s5<<8)|s2=N; loads slot-array base s1=0x8016986c; then loops (LAB_80145974): event_fiber_yield one frame, rescan coop slots 1..15 -- while any slot is active (+0x48!=0) AND its kind (+0x4c)==N keep yielding; release when none match (nothing pending -> releases after 1 yield). Generic form of Wait Sprite Move {6F}/Wait Rotate {64}: same slot array + yield, but kind is the operand and there is no +0x50 unit filter. [VERIFIED live: Task=4 blocked slot2 kind4 255f; poll loop disasm-direct] [SD] [MD:wait_for_instruction_halt_decode.md]

Cooperative-task spawn/slot-init primitive (was event_fiber_register_handler; promoted from LOW). event_task_spawn(a0=slot_idx, a1=fiber_entry): slot=slot0(0x8016986c)+a0*0x400; writes +0x38=FUN_8014cbb4() ctx, +0x3c/+0x40=slot+0x3f0 (fiber stack top), +0x44=entry(a1), +0x48=1 (ACTIVE -- the busy flag every Wait-family barrier polls), +0x4c=0 (kind, stamped later by event_task_set_kind), +0xc=0. Action opcodes (Display Message, Camera, ...) call this and FALL THROUGH -- they never yield; only Wait-family opcodes halt the caller. [VERIFIED: field writes disasm-direct 0x8014c8cc..0x8014c8ec] [SD] [MD:wait_for_instruction_halt_decode.md, SPRITE_MOVE_INVESTIGATION.md]

Arms a unit's walk velocity from the incoming Speed<<8: unit+0x38 = Speed<<9 (velocity magnitude, sll v0,s4,0x1), unit+0x3c = 0x2000, unit+0x98 = 0 (path index). Stores @0x8008c77c-90. +0x38 is the movement-speed field SHARED with battle movement. [MD:SCENARIO6_CHASE_WALK_TIMING.md §5.1b]

Per-frame position integrator: unit+0x18 += unit+0x28 once per game-loop frame (@0x8006af9c-a8). Movement-state switch on unit+0x7f (switchD_8006b068) dispatches ground-walk vs jump-arc; reloads velocity via project_velocity_onto_dir at tile boundaries. Walk cadence = 224/Speed frames/tile (14 @ Speed 16, no ease-in; live-validated). NB tile pitch 0x1C000 is DERIVED (28<<0xc), NOT a literal here (fn divides by 7 via the 0x92492493 reciprocal). See plate. [MD:SCENARIO6_CHASE_WALK_TIMING.md §5.1c]

Projects velocity magnitude (a1) onto the unit direction vector: unit+0x28/+0x2c/+0x30 = (magnitude x dir) >> 12 (mult; sra 0xc; @0x80069dfc-e30). Cardinal dir=0x1000 -> vel = magnitude = Speed<<9. [MD:SCENARIO6_CHASE_WALK_TIMING.md §5.1c]

Sets up the movement direction vector, scaling its 3 components by the game-loop delta multiplier DAT_80045980 (mult @0x800696d4-fc). =1 in event/cinematic state -> one integration per VBlank. [MD:SCENARIO6_CHASE_WALK_TIMING.md §5.1c,§7]

Jump-arc vertical acceleration constant = 0x925 (2341) per frame. Read ONLY by unit_move_stepper's jump/arc switch cases (lw @0x8006b29c..0x8006b7a0), never the ground-walk case (LAB_8006b160) -- so it is the JUMP accel, not walk accel. [MD:SCENARIO6_CHASE_WALK_TIMING.md §5.1c]

column5: {63} CameraSpeedCurve byte. (b&0xF0)>>4 = ease intensity I; b&3 = ease shape (0 linear / 1 ease-in / >=2 symmetric ease-in-out); (b>>2)&3 = field gate (0 = position fields only get the curve). Consumed by the {19} task body: prog(t) = (16-I)/16*t + I/16*easeQuad(t), bit-exact for 0xAA. W: {63} @0x80144ca4 + 3 camera-setup resets; R: {19} task body @0x80146118. [MD:CAMERA_ROTATION_OPCODES_63_73_19_INVESTIGATION.md §3.2,§4.7,§4.8]

Reads the following {19} deltas via event_bytecode_reader_c, computes pan speed = sqrt(sum(delta^2))/Time (mult @0x8014785c-6c, sqrt SUB_8001bf38 @0x801478b0, div @0x801478c0), and patches the following {19} Camera Time operand via event_camera_operand_halfword_store (0x80146094). CORRECTS prior notes that attributed {38} to FUN_801474a4 (that is the {73} handler). [MD:CAMERA_ROTATION_OPCODES_63_73_19_INVESTIGATION.md §3.7]

Helper: little-endian halfword byte-pair store into a following-opcode operand slot (srl a1,8; sb a1,0(a0); sb hi,1(a0)). [MD:CAMERA_ROTATION_OPCODES_63_73_19_INVESTIGATION.md §3.3]

column5: {47} Add Ghost Unit spawn helper. Prologue addiu sp,-0x48; SOLE caller = the {47} case @0x80145734 (jal FUN_8008cf78). Args (X,Y,Z,Facing,xSP spritesheet,slot,xDR draw). Idempotency gate: jal unit_sprite_object_find(id&0xffff) @0x8008cfb8 -> if a sprite object already exists (v0!=0) returns without spawning (bne @0x8008cfc0); else jal evtchr_queue_enqueue @0x8008d024 pushing a 0x14-byte add-queue entry with the ENTD-unit-struct ptr = 0 (the ghost discriminator: {45} Add-Unit passes the real struct there, {47} passes 0). xSP is a sprite_set id resolved through the SAME unit-sprite VRAM-upload path as {45} Add-Unit. [VERIFIED static: prologue + single caller XREF 0x80145734; jal unit_sprite_object_find @0x8008cfb8; jal evtchr_queue_enqueue @0x8008d024, both inside this fn (0x8008cf78..0x8008d030)] [SD] [MD:ADD_GHOST_UNIT_OPCODE_47.md §2.2,§5]

Id -> sprite/display-object getter. Leaf (no stack frame): loads the list head unit_sprite_list_head (0x80098a54) via lw -0x75ac(v1) then walks the singly-linked list, following the next-ptr at node+0x0 and matching (id & 0xffff) against the id byte at node+0x4; returns the matching node ptr, or 0 if absent. NOT a unit-struct-array resolver -- it is a linked-list lookup. Widely used as the id->object resolver: the {47} ghost idempotency gate (ghost_unit_spawn 0x8008cf78) and its slot-occupied wrapper (unit_sprite_object_exists 0x8008cbb4), the {4E} Unit Shadow toggles (unit_shadow_enable/disable write +0x298 on the returned node), and the {32} Color Unit chain. [VERIFIED static: lw -0x75ac(head)=0x80098a54, lbu node+0x4 id compare @0x8007a6fc, lw node+0x0 next @0x8007a70c] [SD] [MD:ADD_GHOST_UNIT_OPCODE_47.md §2.2,§4.5a]

Boolean 'is this slot/handle occupied' wrapper over unit_sprite_object_find. Prologue addiu sp,-0x18; jal unit_sprite_object_find(a0 & 0xffff) @0x8008cbbc then sltu v0,zero,v0 @0x8008cbc4 -> returns 1 iff a sprite object exists for that handle (0 = free). Used by the {47} case free-slot scan over slots 0..0x14 to pick the first unoccupied one (live: 5/6/7). [VERIFIED static: prologue addiu sp,-0x18, jal FUN_8007a6e4, sltu v0,zero,v0] [SD] [MD:ADD_GHOST_UNIT_OPCODE_47.md §2.1]

{47} Add Ghost Unit index->slot table (halfword per entry, key = xID operand). Written ONLY by the {47} case: after the free-slot scan finds slot s0, sh s0,0x5fe8(at) @0x80145698 stores it at g_ghost_unit_slot_table + xID*2; read back lh v0,0x5fe8(at) @0x80145724 to pass the slot to ghost_unit_spawn. xID (0/1/2) is a small handle, NOT the roster slot (live scn6 [0]=5 [1]=6 [2]=7). Ghost control unit-id = xID+0x64, a separate id space from this table. [VERIFIED static: writer @0x80145698 + reader @0x80145724 only] [SD] [MD:ADD_GHOST_UNIT_OPCODE_47.md §2.1,§3.1]

column5: Core setter/ramp for the {2E} Background full-screen Gouraud gradient. Args a0=Time, a1=colorPtr (target Top at +0, Bottom at +4). Time==0 -> snap: beq t4,zero,LAB_800900f4 @0x80090094 skips the div and writes the target directly. Backend of both {2E} wrapper paths screen_gradient_set (0x800935f4) and screen_gradient_set_backup (0x800901f8). [VERIFIED static: prologue -0x20; Time==0 snap branch @0x80090094; div + sw ...,0xc(a2); reads 0x800a1b18/0x800a1b30] [VERIFIED live: scenario-4 flash1 +17/f snap-arm, decay -4.25/f over 32f] [SD] [MD:LIGHTNING_FLASH_OPCODE_2E_BACKGROUND.md §3,§4]

Calls screen_gradient_color_setter (jal FUN_80090048 @0x80090204) to arm the gradient ramp/snap, THEN additionally writes a secondary resting-copy of the target color to 0x800a1b48 (swr @0x80090224) and 0x800a1b4c (swr @0x80090240). Live scenario-4: the FLASH arms (Unk=1... see note) came through this ra 0x8009020c. NOTE: GAP1 closure (2026-07-05) reads Unk!=0->bare screen_gradient_set, Unk==0->this backup path; the stale doc §3/§7 'open routing' note predates that closure. [VERIFIED static: prologue -0x18; jal FUN_80090048; swr 0x800a1b48/0x800a1b4c; dispatched @0x801450b0] [SD] [MD:LIGHTNING_FLASH_OPCODE_2E_BACKGROUND.md §3]

{2E} Background setter path taken when the Unk operand byte (s1[7]) != 0 (dispatched jal @0x801450c4, a0=Time=s1[6]). Prologue addiu sp,-0x18. Thin wrapper: just calls screen_gradient_color_setter (jal FUN_80090048 @0x800935fc, ra=0x80093604) with no secondary copy. Live scenario-4: the gradient DECAYS returned through ra 0x80093604 -- matches this jal-return. [VERIFIED static: prologue -0x18; jal FUN_80090048 @0x800935fc -> ra 0x80093604; dispatched @0x801450c4] [VERIFIED live: decay ra=0x80093604] [SD] [MD:LIGHTNING_FLASH_OPCODE_2E_BACKGROUND.md §3,§4]

Screen-wide colour-field applier -- backend of event opcode {33} Color Field (the screen sibling of {32} Color Unit). Prologue addiu sp,-0x28. Sign-extends the R/G/B operands (sll 0x10; sra 0x10 on a2/a3/v1 @0x80093178..0x800931a8) so they act as signed deltas, then jal color_tint_blend_apply (0x8008f710) -- the SAME shared CLUT view-palette engine used by {32}/{1A}, tinting map+sprite views. Dispatched from the inline {33} case @0x8014516c (5-byte body decoded there: a0=Color/mode s1[0], a1=Time s1[4], R/G/B signed s1[1..3]); also called at map-setup sites 0x801a36d8/0x801a4290. In scenario-4 each {2E} lightning flash is paired 1:1 with a {33} that pushes the map blue-hue (e.g. signed (-8,0,+4)).
